name: Louisiana
notes: Louisiana supports digital ID through the LA Wallet app. Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet are not currently supported.

wallets.name: LA Wallet
steps: Download the LA Wallet app from the App Store or Google Play.
Create an account and verify your identity.
Follow the in-app prompts to add your Louisiana driver's license or ID.
Scan the front and back of your physical ID.
Your digital ID will be available in LA Wallet once approved.
